name: OpenSkillEval
intro: OpenSkillEval 是自动审计开放 skill 生态的 Agent 评测框架。它从五类真实应用的工件或源材料反向构造任务，经生成器与 verifier 形成677个动态案例；同时从多个社区仓库按采用度筛选30个 skill，并在统一隔离环境中比较无 skill 与强制使用 skill 的 Agent，从 ATIF 轨迹和最终工件两条通道评测。
org: Singapore Management University, Fudan University, Joy Future Academy, JD
build_method: 动态任务构建, 社区技能收集, 统一Agent runner
metric: 任务专用工件质量, Skill增益, 轨迹遵循, Token与时间成本
modality: 文本, 图像, 文档, 代码
task_type: Agent任务, 技能评估, 真实工作流
eval_feature: 技能生态审计, 动态任务, 成本质量分析
task_type_en: Agent task, Skill evaluation, Real-world workflow
build_method_en: Dynamic task construction, community skill collection, unified agent runner
eval_feature_en: Skill ecosystem audit, dynamic tasks, cost-quality analysis
intro_en: OpenSkillEval automatically audits the open skill ecosystem for LLM agents. It reverse-constructs tasks from artifacts or source materials in five real application families and uses generators plus a verifier to produce 677 dynamic cases. It also selects 30 skills from multiple community repositories using adoption signals and compares no-skill with force-use agents in a unified isolated environment through both ATIF trajectory and final-artifact evaluation.
metric_en: Task-specific Artifact Quality, Skill Gain, Trajectory Adherence, Token and Time Cost
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select five real-world task families: slides, web design, posters, data visualization, and reports"] --> B["Collect artifacts or source materials such as webpages, websites, poster briefs, open datasets, and visualization examples"]
    B --> C["Use LLM reverse construction to extract structured task specifications and natural-language instructions"]
    C --> D["Validate task-spec consistency and source compatibility, yielding 677 dynamic task instances"]
    D --> E["Collect and organize 30 high-adoption community skills by task category"]
    E --> F["Run agents with and without skills in a unified Harbor/Docker execution environment"]
    F --> G["Analyze ATIF trajectories to see whether skills are invoked and followed"]
    F --> H["Evaluate final artifacts with task-specific VLM, code, screenshot, and rubric checks"]
    G --> I["Compare quality, skill gain, trajectory behavior, diversity, and token/time cost"]
    H --> I

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.23657 Sections 2.1-2.3 and its appendices plus the official project page. The diagrams preserve the five task families; category-specific artifact and source collection; snapshot source packages; reverse construction with Claude-4.6-Opus and GPT-5.2 into task_input.json and instruction.md; verifier-LLM grounding and completeness checks; 677 dynamic cases; time-sensitive collection from multiple community skill repositories and adoption-based filtering to 30 skills; unified isolated agent execution under no-skill and force-use conditions; ATIF trajectory normalization and agent-as-judge workflow adherence; task-specific VLM, screenshot, interaction, code, and rubric artifact checks; and quality, skill-gain, token, time, and cost-performance reporting.
